title: Handwritten scrap
about: A note written by hand on a scrap of paper folded in nine, lying on a dark desk; it prints on a white page, ready to cut out and fold.

fields.prop_font: The writer's hand: a Google Fonts family, e.g. Covered By Your Grace (Reenie Beanie when left out)
fields.prop_paper: The paper: chart for ruled chart paper with a margin line; plain when left out
fields.prop_plate: A caption above the sheets on screen; it never prints
